items.definition:
a person who plans the form or structure of something
She works as a fashion designer.

a precious stone; a geometric shape
She wore a beautiful diamond ring.

the spirit of a dead person
They say the old house is haunted by a ghost.

the activity of chasing and killing wild animals
Deer hunting is a popular sport in this region.

a set of articles or equipment for a specific purpose
He bought a first-aid kit for his car.

an act of praying
She said a silent prayer before bed.

earth, ground
The plants grow well in rich soil.

infectious agent; computer program
The doctor said it was a common cold virus.

a person who walks; a frame for support
The old man used a walker to move around.

a state of physical ease and freedom from pain or constraint
She found comfort in her old blanket.

a line on a surface where it has broken
There's a crack in the window.

a floor of a ship; a pack of cards
We played cards with a new deck.

a mythical creature
Dragons are often depicted in fantasy stories.

sickness
She is recovering from a long illness.

something that is regarded as more important than others
Safety is our top priority.

the action of promoting someone to a higher position or rank
She received a promotion at work last week.

a bar or series of bars, typically fixed on upright supports, serving as a barrier or support
The train runs on a steel rail.

the action of fixing or mending something
The car needs a major repair.

the part of a plant that attaches it to the ground or to a support
The tree has deep roots.

the end or finish of an event or process
In conclusion, we need to work together.

a piece of a homogeneous solid substance having a natural geometric form
The chandelier was made of sparkling crystal.

a period of time by which something is late
There was a significant delay in the flight.

the act of coming to rest on a surface
The plane made a smooth landing.

a sheet or thickness of material
There was a thick layer of dust on the old books.

a person who takes part in something
Each participant received a certificate.

literary work in verse
She enjoys reading modern poetry.

a type of football
Rugby is a popular sport in New Zealand.

a sudden event that causes great damage or loss of life
The earthquake was a natural disaster.

the condition of being physically fit and healthy
Regular exercise improves your fitness.

the duration of a person's life
It was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

the branch of science concerned with the nature and properties of matter and energy
She is studying physics at university.

the process of translating words or text from one language into another
The translation of the document was accurate.

corner, perspective
The angle of the roof was steep.

test, trial
They conducted an experiment to test the hypothesis.

type of bird
A blue jay landed on the branch.

reporter, writer for news
The journalist interviewed the politician.

factory, grinding machine
The old mill was converted into apartments.

event, special time
It was a special occasion for the family.

speed, rhythm
He walked at a slow pace.

ownership, belonging
He took possession of the new house.

rotation, twist
The ball had a lot of spin.

small stream
We found a small creek flowing through the woods.

money in circulation
The local currency is the euro.

public display
We visited an art exhibition at the museum.

burial ceremony
Many people attended the funeral.

curved piece of metal
Hang your coat on the hook.

person who hunts
The hunter tracked the deer through the snow.

direction; teaching
Please read the instructions carefully.

piece of wood
We threw another log on the fire.

person held captive
The prisoner attempted to escape.

feeling of sadness about something that happened
He expressed his deep regret for the mistake.

holiday destination; last option
We stayed at a beautiful beach resort.

regular way of doing things
My morning routine includes exercise.

a period of time; a magical charm
We had a cold spell last week.

a brief statement of the main points
Please give me a summary of the meeting.

a weapon with a long metal blade
The knight carried a shining sword.

something important that you succeed in doing
Winning the award was a great achievement.

the legal dissolution of a marriage
They decided to get a divorce.

all the visible features of an area of land
The landscape was beautiful with rolling hills.

a fixed regular payment, typically paid on a monthly or biweekly basis
He earns a good salary at his new job.

the written text of a play, film, or broadcast
The actors are rehearsing the new script.

a long, narrow piece of material
She cut the fabric into long strips.

a long, hollow cylinder
Water flows through the tube.

the upper front part of the body
He felt a pain in his breast.
